limitations: REALEC publishes no author or prompt identifiers (authorIdentityAvailable is false), so writer clusters are inferred from function-word frequencies and mean sentence/token length; the proxy can merge different writers and split one writer. Near-duplicate detection uses exact word 5-gram Jaccard overlap and cannot catch paraphrase or translation reuse; cross-split duplicates are dropped rather than reassigned. Split sizes target 70/15/15 by document, not by writer or token, and whole writer clusters move together only within the proxy's accuracy. The test split is evaluation-only and must not be used for training or tuning.
